result.reason: The redline satisfies at least the fallback by covering Affiliates and permitting assignment to a successor in an M&A transaction, and it also adds contractor use and an uncured-material-breach termination standard. It does not reach the full preferred position because it leaves the licence term-limited and does not make any paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable; moreover, other termination rights may remain elsewhere in the Agreement. The changes are confined to the playbook issues and preserve the Field of Use, payment and renewal framework. Drafting quality is reduced because Sections (e) and (c) remain facially inconsistent with the new grant and assignment language, relying on a broad notwithstanding clause rather than conforming those provisions, and the reference to 'such immediate termination' was not updated.
